signals.content: We’ve written an FAQ to answer some of the questions we've received about watermarking. In summary: • We’re implementing watermarking to comply with the EU AI Act. Other major model developers have signed the same Code of Practice and will also be implementing watermarking; • Our watermarking method doesn’t have any practical impact on the quality or content of Claude’s outputs; • The difference between watermarked and un-watermarked text will not be distinguishable to readers; • Nothing is added to the text and there are no hidden characters; • Watermarking doesn’t require extra tokens, and will not be more expensive; • Watermarks can’t be traced to a specific person, organization, or chat. Read more: https://t.co/G76iUOJ7Hu

signals.title: @DIU_x: After a thoughtful search, DIU is proud to announce we've selected two new portfolio directors. Dr. Jarred Conley will lead Autonomous Warfa
signals.content: After a thoughtful search, DIU is proud to announce we've selected two new portfolio directors. Dr. Jarred Conley will lead Autonomous Warfare. Autonomous systems are reshaping the battlefield, and Jarred is the right leader to translate our competitive playbook into fielded combat power. Jarred brings a proven track record of fielding capabilities for DIU and the Department of the Navy. David Payne will lead Kill Web. He steps into this position after serving as DIU’s Acting Portfolio Director for Autonomous Warfare. The Kill Web portfolio has a clear mission: harness the rapid expansion of the commercial space industry and emerging electronic technologies to forge an unbreakable fires network. David is a former Principal Systems Engineer for NASA and vice president of a commercial space startup. As the Kill Web director, he will tie industry developments to operational problems, bringing the full force of America’s high-tech markets to the doorstep of our enemies. Please join us in congratulating Jarred and David on their portfolio director roles.
